sources.supports: Player level 5 unlocks the system; expansion rights are spent by choosing Add Block and a cell. These quotes do not specify later reward levels.
Leveling increases available cells from four to thirteen. Author reports using four loadouts plus a blank fifth. Exact reward levels are not listed.
extendSkillGrid/openGrids transmits chosen cells; per-grid remaining rights control Expand; profile storage and UI index checks allow five grids.
